title: The plants told the Amazonians how to make ayahuasca

tellings.quote: They will say well the plants told us

plain: A neuroscientist, Andrew Gallimore, says that when people in the Amazon are asked how they learned to make ayahuasca, a vision-inducing brew made from local plants, they answer that the plants told them. He raises it because, taken at face value, it would mean knowledge can come from something beyond ordinary human discovery.
